commands: # Ensure wwwroot is set to training.tsin.ca (replace if present, otherwise insert before require_once)

if grep -Eq '^\s*\$CFG->wwwroot\s*=' $CFG; then sed -i -E "s|^\s*\$CFG->wwwroot\s*=.*|\$CFG->wwwroot = '$TARGET';|" $CFG; else sed -i "/require_once.*lib\/setup.php/i \$CFG->wwwroot = '$TARGET';" $CFG; fi
php -l $CFG || { echo 'PHP syntax error in config.php'; exit 4; }
echo -n 'Contains elearning.tsin.ca? '; (grep -F "elearning.tsin.ca" $CFG && echo YES) || echo NO
